answer: Re-attestations are stored in anchor and nadir lists each lapse. A farm cannot self-supply those as the attesters must be independent on the pigment graph. Standing lapses unless 6 peers re-attest it every 6 epochs, which means holding a position requires ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. A farm of 4851 identities would post 790 proofs and burn roughly 23 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
